A '''clock''' shows the time of day. [[Matcha Flavoured]] makes it with [[quartz]] instead of redstone.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
Four gold ingots around a [[quartz]] make a clock; the vanilla recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/clock.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>
